thread:
Carla Ramos: heads-up — vendor flagged a potential firmware late-breaker on H200 that could impact the marketplace SKU cutover next week. can we triage impact and decide press/embargo moves? :eyes:
Ben Cho: ugh. what exactly is the failure mode?
Carla Ramos: vendor says some H200 units with driver v2.3.1 + custom DC firmware will drop to 0% performance under long seq workloads. repro attached: link to internal lab log (s3://redwood-labs/h200/firmware-fail.log)
Alice Nguyen: do we know if MI300 or Gaudi variants are affected or just H200?
Carla Ramos: vendor says H200 only, tied to a power-scaling path. MI300/GAUDI unaffected per their initial triage.
Devon Patel: assigning triage owner: @Ben can you spin up a quick repro on staging and run our perf-gate?
Ben Cho: on it. will run the stress harness with --seq-len=2048 and --use-kvcache. I'll post results in ~30m.
announce-bot: Marketplace cutover job #MKT-CUTOVER scheduled for 2026-04-05T18:00Z. Created by sam-ops.
Eva Morgan: legal note — if we delay announcement we need to check embargo language and partner comms. I'll loop legal + comms.
Alice Nguyen: ops question: do we have a fallback SKU mapping to CPU or B200 for customers who need immediate availability?
Carla Ramos: suggested fallback: advertise B200/older H100 for the first wave; hold H200 in the marketplace until firmware patch validated.
Ben Cho: repro shows perf drop at 12m into the run. stacktrace snippet:
```
[ERR] power_scale: voltage over-threshold -> throttle
[WARN] kv_cache_miss spike
```
Looks firmware -> driver handshake.
Devon Patel: mitigation options: a) delay H200 listing; b) gate H200 behind driver v2.3.2 (vendor patch); c) automatic routing to H100/B200 for affected customers until patch.
Carla Ramos: we need decision by EOD to lock press window. comms: if we delay, CS and partners need a 72h heads-up.
Alice Nguyen: ops can implement automatic routing in the runtime — set model-routing policy to prefer fallback SKUs for routes tagged `marketplace_beta`. Can push a patch today.
Ben Cho: vendor says patch ETA 48-72h. we should plan for their 72h worst case.
Eva Morgan: recommend we prepare embargo contingency wording now. I'll draft: "Due to last-minute vendor firmware regression, H200 availability will be staggered. Customers will be routed to validated alternatives until remediation is complete."
announce-bot: Reminder: press embargo window opens 2026-04-03T08:00Z.
Carla Ramos: OK. proposed plan:
- Today: Ben runs full perf/regressions and posts log. Ops prepares routing policy patch (Alice). Legal drafts contingency comms (Eva).
- +48h: vendor patch candidate validation in lab. If passes, can proceed with limited H200 listing with canary wave (5%).
- +72-96h: full cutover if no regressions. Otherwise keep H200 gated and notify partners.
Devon Patel: I'll own rollback/runbook and prepare runbook snippets. sample command to reroute:
```
redwood route update --route marketplace_beta --preferred-skus H100,B200 --drain H200
```
Carla Ramos: please add owners in the doc (link to spreadsheet). also tag SI leads to postpone joint announce rehearsals for H200-specific sessions.
Ben Cho: test results posted: reproducer fails on 3/3 runs. attaching logs. :frowning_face:
Alice Nguyen: ops patch is ready in staging. will flip on a feature-flag for routing once we get signoff.
Eva Morgan: comms draft ready for review. pinging comms and partner-ops.
Carla Ramos: thanks team. decision checkpoint at 18:00Z today. if vendor patch not validated, we hold H200 and proceed with B200/H100-only press plan. :thumbsup:
